time.source: Paper Table II and the M1 contract. Landing hover remains 5 s and only starts at a registered pad.

motion.wind_source: Synthetic calm. Wind is not estimated in M1.2.
motion.start_state: Landed at the registered pad. Remote backhaul and wait stay airborne and keep hover propulsion. Airborne wait is subject to the return-reserve check. Only return, after the pad radius and speed gates and the landing hover, turns propulsion off.

geometry.note: Same pads and buoys as M1. Geometry is not refit to create a calibration benefit.

belief.quadrature: Gauss-Legendre weights on the quantile coordinate u in (0, 1): expectation is sum w_i f(F^{-1}(u_i)). The count stays the smallest registered candidate inside the moment and Q tolerances. Equal-width support nodes remain only as the known narrow-posterior counterexample.
belief.source: Support matches Table II. Kernel std and noise stay the M1 synthetic contract.

utility.formula: J = on_time_bits / b_ref - lambda_e * sum_m energy_used_j / e_ref
utility.source: Same shape as paper equation (7). Scales stay the M1 values.

energy.bulk_source: Synthetic short-range data-product radio. Not LoRa and not an old service radius.
energy.battery_rule: Recheck 52156.035109573495 J first and do not replace it by default. The necessary script window is chain-at-theta-1 complete cost plus reserve <= B and B < prior-q95 far complete cost plus reserve. The posterior 0.95 completion quote from the post-calibration state must also fit the remaining energy; theta=1 true cost is not that conservative prediction. Reserve is outside the quote. If a second condition is required, it is only the chain at support endpoint 1.4 plus the same reserve and margin. Do not search another battery after seeing rewards.

radio.reuse: LoRa airtime, current and the M0A k=4/3 horizon. Commands, acks and telemetry are LoRa. The bulk product is not credited on LoRa.

lookahead.terminal: One decision interval of physical rollout plus one best remaining business. The business quote includes backhaul, return and landing, and that cost is charged in the value. Cached bits and a new target are alternatives, not a sum. The other UAV waits. gamma=1. Not an exact Bayes optimum.
lookahead.noise: Future telemetry noise is Gauss-Hermite or, for a reference grid larger than 5, equal-probability normal nodes. Zero noise is not the planning expectation.

integral.tie_rule: Among scores within tie_abs, pick service by ascending buoy id, then backhaul, return, wait, calibrate. This band is fixed here and is not widened to the measured Q gap.

development_states.name: pad_prior
development_states.note: Sentinel battery control. Not a mission sample.

development_states.name: pad_narrow
development_states.note: Narrow interior kernel on the sentinel pad.

development_states.name: lower_edge_pad
development_states.note: Lower-edge posterior on the sentinel pad.

development_states.name: tight_pad
development_states.note: Registered sensitive candidate at the pad. Quadrature probe, not a retuned budget.

development_states.name: outbound_tight
development_states.note: Mid-route on the registered far line with the candidate battery.

development_states.name: cached_backhaul
development_states.note: One cached low-value packet at its buoy, still airborne.

development_states.name: calibration_switch
development_states.note: Narrow posterior near the end of the registered calibration pattern. Battery is still the candidate, not a fitted remainder.

integral.selection: Smallest registered candidate that meets the tolerances. If none do, return NOT_MET and do not keep the last candidate. Do not read mission utility.

matched_planner: Both methods call the same finite lookahead. The only switch is whether calibrate is in the candidate set.
ablation: At most the first calibration in each sensitive base, from the calibration-on mission, and only if that comparison runs. Two continuations share the post-calibration physical state and then forbid further calibration.
